About

Maya Moon Collective is a cacao cafe and community collective tucked into Adams Avenue in Normal Heights, pouring ceremonial drinking cacao, specialty coffee, and herbal lattes alongside organic farm-to-table pastries and savory bites. Everything on the menu is naturally sweetened with zero refined sugars, and the space doubles as a gathering point for art installations, evening events, and makers markets that rotate through bi-monthly.

If you have been meaning to book a moon meditation session or reserve the space for a ceremonial cacao gathering, this is the kind of spot worth planning ahead for. Right now the easiest way to lock in a date is to call or stop by, since there is no online booking system yet, and a well-organized listing goes a long way in helping people find the hours, the menu, and a direct line to reach the collective.
